# GlobeCareer — International Career Platform

> GlobeCareer (https://globecareer.com) is a 100% free international CV/resume builder, career document suite, and global job search platform. It features country-specific CV formatting across 40 jurisdictions, ATS optimization, and zero paywalls or subscriptions.

## Core Free Capabilities

- **International Resume Builder (`/resume-builder`):** Interactive CV creator with real-time ATS keyword matching, photo/no-photo compliance for 40 countries, and free vector PDF and DOCX export.
- **Resume & CV Templates (`/templates`):** Country-tailored single-column ATS layouts and European photo CV formats.
- **Professional Bio Generator & Templates (`/bio-generator`, `/bio-templates`):** 15+ industry templates with Short, Medium, and Extended outputs in 1st and 3rd person POV.
- **Resume Summary & Objective Generator (`/summary-generator`, `/summary-templates`):** 18+ ATS-tested professional summaries, graduate objectives, and LinkedIn headlines with 1-click resume builder insertion.
- **Resignation Letter Generator (`/resignation-letter`, `/resignation-letter-templates`):** 11+ departure scenarios (2-weeks notice, short notice, immediate effect, relocation, retirement) with global notice rules (US, UK, DE, AU) and printable export.
- **Cover Letter Builder (`/cover-letter-builder`):** Tailored cover letters with country-specific norms and export.
- **Recommendation Letter Builder & Guide (`/recommendation-letter`, `/recommendation-letter-guide`):** Academic, employment, and graduate reference letters.
- **Job Application Email Generator (`/email-generator`):** Formal application emails, cold outreach messages, and follow-ups.
- **Letter & Email Templates (`/letter-templates`):** Curated outreach and reference letter templates.
- **ATS Resume Checker (`/ats-checker`):** Real-time resume vs. job description match score, missing skills analysis, and formatting audits.
- **Interview Preparation (`/interview-prep`):** STAR method frameworks, mock practice questions, and international hiring etiquette.
- **Verified Jobs Portal (`/jobs`):** Authenticated international and remote positions with verified employer links and anti-scam safeguards.
- **Job Application Tracker (`/job-tracker`):** Free Kanban pipeline for tracking wishlists, applied roles, interviews, offers, and follow-up deadlines.
- **40 Country CV Hiring Guides (`/country-guides`):** Specific rules on photos, paper sizes (Letter vs. A4), document length, and data privacy for 40 nations: US, UK, Canada, Germany, Australia, France, Japan, UAE, Singapore, Netherlands, Switzerland, Spain, Ireland, New Zealand, Sweden, Poland, and more.

## Platform Standards

- **100% Free:** No credit cards, no subscriptions, no watermarks, no gated downloads.
- **Privacy First:** Client-side local storage draft persistence.
- **Canonical Domain:** https://globecareer.com
- **Sitemap:** https://globecareer.com/sitemap.xml
